key_insight: Cura 1T is a healthcare-specialized LLM built to improve patient communication, clinical reasoning, and tool use through a human-gated self-evolution training loop.
clinical_relevance: The model is designed to better support healthcare workflows such as consultation, image-and-text reasoning, interactive diagnosis, and EHR tool use without sacrificing broader reasoning ability.
method: Human-gated self-evolution loop to plan and target the next capability to improve
Train on targeted synthetic and curated examples based on observed failures
Evaluate benchmark trajectories and refine the data mixture each round
evidence_signal: Across a healthcare evaluation suite, Cura 1T ranks at or near the top among frontier baselines while staying competitive on out-of-domain reasoning and agentic benchmarks.
watch_item: As with any specialized healthcare model, performance gains may depend on careful validation in real workflows, especially because improving one capability can degrade another.
paper_title: Cura 1T: Specialized Model for Agentic Healthcare
